newsitem.title: FRANCE: Rennes airport sees strong Jan-Nov 96 cargo growth.
newsitem.headline: Rennes airport sees strong Jan-Nov 96 cargo growth.

text.p: Rennes-St Jacques airport handled 3,025 tonnes of air cargo and trucked airfreight in the first ten months of 1996, an increase of 3.8 percent on 1995 levels, airport authority figures show.
Air cargo totalled 2,799 tonnes, up 40.5 percent on January-November 1995.
Rennes sole "all cargo" flight is a nightly service operated by Air Jet, the airline subsidiary of French air and road express distribution group, Jet Services.
Rennes features as a stopover on Air Jet's British Aerospace BAe146QC (quick change) cargo service whose full itinerary reads: Paris/CDG-Strasbourg-Montpellier-Rennes-Marseille-Paris/CDG.
The Air Jet service alone handled 2,624 tonnes of airfreight between January and November 1996 up 55.1 percent on 1995 levels.
French airlines - Air France Europe, Brit Air, Regional Airlines and Flandre Air - operate passenger services from Rennes Airport.
Trucked airfreight handled at the airport totalled 225 tonnes, down 15.6 percent on the first eleven months of 1995.
Postal traffic handled at Rennes airport totalled 4,300 tonnes, up 10.7 percent on the same period the previous year.

French airline, L'Aeropostale, carries overnight mail between its Paris-Charles de Gaulle hub and Rennes on a regular basis using a Boeing 737QC aircraft. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
